manager.title: Pump attendants and validation requests
manager.description: Prepare pump attendants, group them into a document, then explicitly submit the request to the supervisor.
manager.candidatesDescription: Creating a pump attendant never submits a request automatically.
manager.noCandidatesDescription: All currently available pump attendants have already been processed or validated.
manager.requestsDescription: Track prepared, submitted, returned, or completed requests.

supervisor.title: Pump attendant validation
supervisor.description: Review each document and make one decision for all pump attendants it contains.
supervisor.requestsDescription: A pending request is one required action at document level.
supervisor.noRequestsDescription: New requests submitted by managers will appear here.

feedback.candidateCreated: The pump attendant was prepared without automatic submission.
feedback.candidateUpdated: The pump attendant information was updated.
feedback.requestCreated: The document was created as a draft.
feedback.submit: The request was submitted to the supervisor.
feedback.approve: The document and its pump attendants were validated.
feedback.return: The document was returned for correction.

errors.load: Unable to load pump attendants and requests.
errors.saveCandidate: Unable to save the pump attendant.
errors.mixedStations: A document can only group pump attendants assigned to the same station.
errors.action: The action could not be completed.

candidateForm.createDescription: The pump attendant remains editable and no request is sent at this stage.
candidateForm.editDescription: Update the allowed information before the next submission.
candidateForm.noAutomaticSubmission: This creation triggers neither a notification nor an automatic validation.

detail.snapshotNotice: Displayed information comes from the auditable document; allowed corrections remain linked to the related accounts.
detail.historyDescription: All transitions and their actors are retained.

confirm.submitDescription: One required-action notification will be sent to the supervisor for this document.
confirm.approveDescription: All pump attendants in the document will be validated and receive their activation invitation.
confirm.returnDescription: Tell the manager which corrections are required. The next submission will create a new required action.
confirm.rejectDescription: The document will be closed without validating its pump attendants.
confirm.cancelDescription: The document will be closed and its pump attendants will not be validated.
